title: Bound on Register Growth
statement: Let $R\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\Lambda$ be a set of labels, let $P$ be a counter program over $R$ registers with labels in $\Lambda$, and fix an input bit string $x$. For every abstract state $s$, register $r$, and $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the value of register $r$ after $t$ steps from $s$ is at most its initial value plus $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $R\in\mathbb{N}$ and $\Lambda$ is a set of labels.
$P$ is a counter program over $R$ registers and labels in $\Lambda$.
An input bit string $x$ is fixed.
replaced:
Let $P$ be a counter program over $R$ registers with labels in $\Lambda$, $x$ an input bit
string, $s$ an abstract state with registers $\rho$, $r$ a register and $t \in \mathbb{N}$. If
$\rho'$ denotes the registers of the state reached from $s$ after $t$ steps of $P$ on $x$, then
$\rho'(r) \le \rho(r) + t$.
